notes: Two ASV marginal notes ('Or, The words of Lemuel king of Massa' and 'Or, burden') were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.

The chain's 'of' is placed on the nomen rectum Lemuel under rule 19 even though the ASV writes it before the appositional 'king'; the unit is discontinuous under rule 25 and 'king' keeps only its own word.
